slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the profit target of at least 3000 yuan per week a hard constraint that must be satisfied, or is it the objective to maximize profit with 3000 yuan as a minimum acceptable threshold
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the objective is to maximize weekly profit, satisfying the semantic hit rule for the objective slot.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing process idle time or a cost-weighted multi-objective. Its later broad question about additional requirements/constraints did not specifically target idle time or unused capacity.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Only profit maximization is the objective; idle time of the manufacturing, assembly, and inspection processes does not need to be minimized or included with cost-proportional weights.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time minimization, and its READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit as the objective, thereby assuming away the hidden P1 objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 profit-objective slot was resolved, but the P1 idle-time minimization objective remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the core profit maximization objective and key constraints, but it failed to ask about the idle-time minimization secondary objective and stopped prematurely with that P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
